import pandas as pd
import os

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/32468/1_32468_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/32468_2_845b44ea/1_32468_output.xlsx"

# Read all sheets
xls = pd.ExcelFile(input_path)
sheets = {name: pd.read_excel(xls, name, header=None) for name in xls.sheet_names}

summary = sheets["SUMMARY"].copy()
discount = sheets["DISCOUNT"].copy()

target_col_idx = 8

discount_dates = pd.to_datetime(discount.iloc[:, 0], errors="coerce")
discount_amounts = pd.to_numeric(discount.iloc[:, 1], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)

results = []

    # get start date from column 7 if present else column 1
    start_date = None

    if r < len(summary) and len(summary.columns) > 7:
        start_date = summary.iat[r, 7]

    if (pd.isna(start_date) or start_date is None) and r < len(summary) and len(summary.columns) > 1:

    # write numeric value (float)

if summary.shape[0] < max_row_needed:

        summary = summary.append(pd.Series([pd.NA]*summary.shape[1]), ignore_index=True)
